# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# scenario: --scenario syncing. THE CHECK_CORE_READY() ANSWER, and the reason this file exists.
# on_get_last_block_header opens with CHECK_CORE_READY() (src/rpc/core_rpc_server.cpp:2453); the
# macro (:477) sets res.status = CORE_RPC_STATUS_BUSY ("BUSY", commands_defs.h:79) and returns the
# VALUE-INITIALISED response - every numeric field 0, every string empty, and NO JSON-RPC error
# object. check_core_ready() is just is_synchronized() (:451-458), so this is the answer for the
# WHOLE initial sync, i.e. for days on a fresh node.
# DESIGN.md §1b.3/§5: rpc/jsonrpc.rs must inspect `status` BEFORE deserializing and turn "BUSY"
# into RpcError::Busy, so status.node.top_block_age_sec is null. Rendering timestamp 0 would print
# a block roughly 56 years old for the whole initial sync.
# Struct shape is identical to get_last_block_header.json (commands_defs.h:1166-1215, :1230-1238);
# only the values differ, because value-initialisation does not drop keys.
